name: frontend-kit-registry
description: Portable frontend feature catalog for AI-assisted page assembly.

usageContract.inputPattern: Use feature IDs such as K-HERO-01, K-FORM-01, K-CTA-01.
agentSteps: Resolve selected IDs in this registry.
Check files, deps, whenToUse, avoidWhen, and promptSnippet.
Adapt to the target project's tokens, routing, and component boundaries.

items.name: BrandDepthBackground
items.whenToUse: Use when a marketing site feels flat and needs subtle premium depth without distracting from content.
items.avoidWhen: Avoid heavy patterns, decorative orbs, or strong gradients on operational dashboards or text-heavy docs.
items.promptSnippet: Use K-BG-01 for subtle blueprint/grid depth. Implement with design tokens only, keep contrast readable, and verify 375/768/1440.

items.name: MeshGradientBackground
items.whenToUse: Use for atmospheric hero or CTA sections where motion can reinforce brand energy.
items.avoidWhen: Avoid when performance budget is tight, the section already has a strong image/video, or reduced-motion users need static clarity.
items.promptSnippet: Use K-BG-02 behind hero/CTA content only. Add reduced-motion fallback and keep foreground text above AA contrast.

items.name: GridTextureOverlay
items.whenToUse: Review WEFLOW kit description: 밋밋한 배경 위에 얇은 선 무늬를 올립니다.
items.avoidWhen: Needs curation. Confirm fit, accessibility, performance, and content truthfulness before reuse.
items.promptSnippet: Consider GridTextureOverlay from @/components/motion. Curate whenToUse/avoidWhen, then adapt it to the target project's tokens, routes, and responsive rules.

items.name: PremiumCardSurface
items.whenToUse: Use on conversion-critical cards, forms, pricing cards, review cards, and comparison panels.
items.avoidWhen: Avoid applying to every small nested element; reserve it for primary surfaces.
items.promptSnippet: Use K-CARD-01 on primary cards only. Do not nest premium cards inside premium cards. Keep border radius consistent with the design system.

items.name: SpotlightCard
items.whenToUse: Use for feature grids where hover should clarify the active card.
items.avoidWhen: Avoid on mobile-only dense lists or inside scroll containers where pointer tracking adds little value.
items.promptSnippet: Use K-CARD-02 for feature/why cards. Ensure the glow follows pointer on desktop and degrades cleanly on touch devices.
